message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) via I‑5 S. Under normal conditions—no major traffic, construction, or weather delays—you’d expect about **6 hours** of driving time. In practice, especially during rush hour or on weekends, it can stretch to **6½–7 hours**. If you’re planning a trip, it’s a good idea to check real‑time traffic updates and allow extra time for stops or detours.
